auth.panelHeadline: Close the day with numbers that agree.
auth.panelBody: Counter sales, online orders, returns and disposals settle into one record. The stock on the screen is the stock on the shelf.
auth.signInHint: Use the email your shop admin registered.
auth.noAccount: No account? Ask your shop admin, or
auth.errBadCredentials: Email or password is incorrect. Check both and try again.
auth.errNetwork: Cannot reach StockFlow. Check the internet connection and try again.
auth.errServer: Something went wrong at our end. Try again in a moment.
auth.errDisabled: This account is no longer active. Ask your shop admin to restore it.
auth.errEmailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
auth.errThrottled: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

ended.foot: A session that has ended cannot be picked up again. Signing in starts a new one on this device.

expired.title: Your session expired
expired.body: This device was not used for a while, so it signed you out on its own to keep the account safe. Sign in again to carry on where you left off.

signedOut.title: You have been signed out
signedOut.body: This session was closed from this browser, in another tab or by signing in again. Sign in to carry on.

signedOutElsewhere.title: Signed out from another device
signedOutElsewhere.body: This device was signed out from the signed-in devices list on another phone or computer. If that was not you, sign in and reset your password straight away.

passwordChanged.title: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: Changing the password signs the account out of its other devices. Sign in with the new password. If you did not change it, reset it now.

accountDisabled.title: This account has been turned off
accountDisabled.body: Your organisation's admin turned this account off, so it was signed out on every device. Ask them to turn it back on.

security.title: Signed out to keep your account safe
security.body: This sign-in was used from somewhere else at the same time, which can mean it was copied, so it was ended everywhere. Sign in again, and if this happens again, reset your password.

reset.requestHint: We email a 6 digit code to the address your shop admin registered. You read it on your phone and type it here.
reset.requestHintShort: We email a 6 digit code to the address your shop admin registered.
reset.requestFoot: No code arriving? Check the spam folder first. If the address on your account is wrong, your shop admin can change it.
reset.codeSent: A code is on its way. Check the inbox for that address.
reset.codeResent: A new code is on its way.
reset.resendIn: You can send another code in {{seconds}}s.
reset.errCodeWrong: That code is not right. Check the email and try again.
reset.errCodeExpired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
reset.errLocked: Too many incorrect codes. Start again to get a new one.
reset.errThrottled: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
reset.errMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.signsOutEverywhere: Setting a new password signs this account out on every device. Anyone still signed in will need the new password to get back in.
reset.doneBody: The new password is active now. A confirmation has gone to
reset.doneBodyTail: so there is a record of when it changed.
reset.doneFoot: You have not been signed in automatically. Counter machines are shared, so the next person at the keyboard has to be the one who signs in.
reset.errNoAccount: No account found with that email address. Check the spelling, or ask your shop admin.

shell.signOutEverywhereBody: This ends every session on this account, on every phone and computer, this one included. Anyone using it will have to sign in again.
shell.signOutEverywhereFailed: Could not sign out the other devices. Check the connection and try again.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.subtitle: Every phone and computer signed in to this account right now. If you do not recognise one, sign it out and change your password.
sessions.confirmOne: Sign this device out? It will have to sign in again.
sessions.confirmOthers: Sign out every other device? This one stays signed in.
sessions.signedOutOthers: Every other device has been signed out.
sessions.onlyThisDevice: No other device is signed in to this account.
sessions.loadFailed: Could not load your signed-in devices. Check the connection and try again.
sessions.actionFailed: Could not sign that device out. Check the connection and try again.

shell.noMatchHint: Try a page name, a word from what it does, or the same word in Bengali.
shell.recentEmptyHint: Pages you open will show up here.
shell.shortcutsSubtitle: What the shell listens for. More arrive as pages are built.
shell.notificationsSample: These are sample alerts, not your business. Real ones arrive once the notifications endpoint is built.
shell.notificationsEmptyHint: Orders, stock and returns that need a decision will show up here.
shell.soonReason: This part is not built yet. It will open here as soon as it is ready.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.accessBody: Sections come from the server, already filtered by role. A narrower role sees fewer.
